# Photo test fixtures

`photo-sample.heic` is a 640×480 HEVC/HEIF colour-bar test card from
<https://loremfile.dev/heic>, released under **CC0 1.0 Universal**. It is used
only to verify that the browser converts an ordinary iPhone-format HEIC photo
to a clean JPEG before upload. No customer data is present.

Source page: <https://loremfile.dev/heic>
